name: sg-cards-guide
description: Information-only guide to Singapore credit cards. Loads an open, issuer-cited dataset live and cites every number. Not financial advice.

interface.longDescription: Answers questions about Singapore credit cards: earn rates, caps, fees, exclusions and sign-up rules, and which of your cards earns more on a purchase. Every number comes from an open dataset of issuer-quoted facts, loaded live at the start of each chat and cited with the issuer link and the date it was last checked. Limitations: information only, not financial advice; covers only the cards in the dataset unless it reads an issuer page live; does not connect to any bank and only knows what you tell it. The plugin stores nothing; anything carried between chats is in ChatGPT's own memory, which you control.
defaultPrompt: What does the DBS Vantage earn on local spend?
Is the UOB Lady's Solitaire capped at S$2,000 a month?
Which rules version are you using?
